items.title: Form 4 with codes and 10b5-1 flag; Forms 3 and 5; 13F with lag label
items.evidence: Insider panel live-data tested: sec-insiders run read 80 Form 4 filings and stored 199 transactions. Panel shows explained transaction codes, role, shares, price, value, shares owned after, the 10b5-1 box (plan, no plan or not stated), 90-day open-market totals, the two-business-day lag, and admits unreadable filings. Verified on the real filing (12 sales, 30,000 shares, $4,542,781.49). Forms 3 and 5 (added 2026-11-24): the parser reads holdings tables, the Form 3 'no securities owned' statement, amendments and joint owners; the job now reads Forms 3, 4, 5 and their amendments; new table insider_holdings and three new insider_filings columns (migration 20261128000000). Panel: all three disclosure lags, a Filed column beside the trade date (a Form 5 can report trades years late), the form and an 'amendment' mark, 90-day totals that leave amendments out (core `summarizeRecentOpenMarket`, tested), and an Initial holdings (Form 3) section with the Form 3 filings, their securities, direct or indirect ownership, restricted stock units shown as 'Not stated, see the filing notes' with the footnote text. Verified on six real documents (Form 3 x3, 3/A, 5, 5/A) against an independent Python reading of the same XML; parser and totals mutation-checked; Node and Deno byte-identical; per-table access test for every Study table. Not done: 13F holders (the vendor serves 13F by the filing fund, not by the stock, so a holder list needs the SEC quarterly 13F data sets); the placeholder now says so.

items.title: 10-K and 10-Q sections and risk-factor diff
items.evidence: Done: year-over-year risk-factor comparison of the two newest 10-Ks (Item 1A), by code with no model (core `riskfactors.ts`, rules riskdiff-1). Data from Massive's 10-K sections endpoint, confirmed entitled on the free plan with the project's own key (real NVIDIA pair recorded in fixtures/massive). New table annual_sections (RLS, owner read), weekly job massive-sections (stocks only; vendor gaps listed, not hidden), panel on the company page that loads the two reports only when opened. Sentence level because page breaks cut paragraphs differently each year; added, removed and edited sentences with the heading each sat under, word-level edits marked by underline and strikethrough (not colour alone), link to each filing. Verified: 33 core tests (hand-checked Dice values, threshold boundaries, page-break joins) mutation-checked; every added, removed and changed sentence of the real pair identical to an independent Python implementation (hash match, 71 new, 49 removed, 66 edited, 449 unchanged); Node and Deno byte-identical; 5 adapter tests and 4 job tests; 2 e2e tests with the real reports. Not done: 10-Q sections (the vendor endpoint offers business and risk_factors for 10-K only), showing the Item 1 business text, tuning the 0.6 cut-off beyond one company pair, and looking at the panel live (needs the signed-in session). Live 2026-11-24: migration applied; the first job run failed on a rate limit (OKLO) and was recorded as an error, the cause (request bucket burst) was fixed, and the rerun stored 19 reports for 10 companies (RGTI has only one year). The company page also carries a 'Not built' placeholder for 10-Q sections, with the reason (the vendor's sections feed is 10-K only).

items.title: Earnings history: reported results, release timing and post-earnings move (estimates, surprise, guidance and implied move need paid data)
items.evidence: packages/core/src/earnings.ts (formula version earnings-1): each reported quarter (SEC facts) is joined to its Item 2.02 8-K (the latest quarter that ended before the release, at most 95 days earlier; the filing date of a figure is not used because prior-year quarters are repeated in later filings), the release is labelled before the open, during the session or after the close in ET, and the move is the close of the first session that could trade on it against the close before (split-window guard, over-25% flag, bar-gap guard). Every gap is stated in words (no 8-K stored, before the first stored price, reacting session not yet priced, split in window). The summary gives the average size with n, up and down counts and a small-sample warning below 30 reports. Estimates, surprise, guidance and the implied move show 'requires a higher Massive plan' or 'needs options data'. 26 core tests with hand-checked arithmetic (-22.5, +10, +20, +5, -23.08), winter and summer time edges at 09:29:59, 09:30:00, 15:59:59 and 16:00:00 ET, mutation-checked (every mutation applied and caught; five survived the first tests and each got a test). Two design bugs found by checking, not by the first tests: same-day releases were ordered by accession instead of acceptance time, and a prior-year quarter with a later 'filed' date stole the release. Node and Deno output is byte-identical (parity script now covers it). 1 e2e test on the page; screenshot reviewed. Known limit: only 8-Ks the SEC job stored are used (its 'recent' list), so older quarters say 'No results 8-K stored for this quarter' until older submission files are loaded (docs/IDEAS.md).

items.title: Regime classifier with event-study statistics
items.evidence: Regime label regime-1 and event studies event-study-1 (ADR 0009): stress, bear, recovery, bull calm, bull correction from the S&P 500 trend, drawdown, VIX and VIX3M. The first draft's recovery rule labelled 30% of all days and was tightened (documented). Day-by-day match with an independent Python implementation over 2,512 sessions (2016 to 2026); known days labelled as history remembers them. New tables regime_daily (each day with its inputs and rule versions, so the label is reproducible from stored data, tested) and regime_event_stats; regime job runs after the FRED job and fails loudly when the S&P 500 is more than 5 days old. Event study: non-overlapping episodes, n, median, quartiles and an all-days benchmark; fewer than 30 episodes shows 'insufficient history', which is most labels with 10 years of free S&P 500 data. Zweig breadth thrust computed with breadth (3.3) and shown on the Regime page. Still to do: capitulation context and the live check of the page. Live 2026-11-25: regime-daily stored 2,512 days on main (latest 2026-11-23: stress; recession filter elevated).
